Container.Name: AliasVault
Container.Overview:
AliasVault is an open-source, privacy-first password and email alias manager. It combines end-to-end encrypted password storage, on-the-fly random email alias generation, a built-in incoming mail server (SMTP), and dedicated client web, desktop, and mobile apps with zero third-party cloud dependencies.
[b]Key Features:[/b] - [b]End-to-End Encryption:[/b] Zero-knowledge client-side encryption keeps all credentials, notes, and aliases completely private to you. - [b]Built-in Email Server:[/b] Generates unique randomized email aliases on-the-fly for every service and receives confirmation emails directly inside the vault. - [b]Official All-in-One Container:[/b] Bundles the web client, REST API, admin panel, task runner, and PostgreSQL database into a single, easy-to-manage container managed by s6-overlay. - [b]Cross-Platform Access:[/b] Accessible via the web dashboard, browser extensions (Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari), and native mobile apps (iOS & Android). - [b]Self-Hosted & Independent:[/b] Zero external telemetry or third-party server requirements.
[b]Initial Setup:[/b] 1. Open the WebUI at [inline]http://[IP]:[PORT:80]/[/inline] to create your personal user account. 2. Access the administrator control panel at [inline]http://[IP]:[PORT:80]/admin[/inline] (user: [inline]admin[/inline]). See container logs for the initial admin password. 3. [b]Reverse Proxy & HTTPS:[/b] For mobile app and remote browser extension connectivity, serve AliasVault behind an HTTPS reverse proxy (e.g. Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik, Caddy, Cloudflare Tunnel) with a publicly trusted SSL certificate. 4. [b]Email Aliases (Optional):[/b] To receive emails for custom domain aliases directly, ensure port 25 is forwarded on your firewall to this container.
[b]Credits & Support:[/b] - AliasVault is created by [b]Leendert de Borst (@lanedirt)[/b] ([url=https://github.com/aliasvault/aliasvault]GitHub[/url] | [url=https://www.aliasvault.com]Website[/url]). Support the developer on [url=https://buymeacoffee.com/lanedirt]Buy Me a Coffee[/url] or [url=https://opencollective.com/aliasvault]Open Collective[/url]. - The donation link below specifically supports the maintenance of this Unraid template repository.

Config.Name: WebUI Port (HTTP)
Config.Description: The host port for AliasVault web interface and API (internal container port is 80).

Config.Name: SMTP Port (Incoming Mail)
Config.Description: Port for incoming SMTP email traffic (forward port 25 on your router for custom alias domains).

Config.Name: SMTP Submission Port
Config.Description: Port for secure SMTP email submission.

Config.Name: Database Storage
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the built-in PostgreSQL database.

Config.Name: Secrets Storage
Config.Description: Persistent storage for auto-generated encryption keys and passwords.

Config.Name: Logs Storage
Config.Description: Persistent storage for server and mail service logs.

Config.Name: Public Registration
Config.Description: Allow users to register new accounts from the web UI (set to 'false' to disable public signups).

Config.Name: Force HTTPS Redirect
Config.Description: Set to 'false' if running behind an external reverse proxy (SWAG, NPM, Traefik) terminating SSL, or 'true' to redirect HTTP to HTTPS.

Config.Name: Admin IP Allowlist
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated IP/CIDR allowlist for accessing the /admin panel (e.g. 192.168.1.0/24).

Config.Name: Trusted Proxies
Config.Description: Upstream proxy IPs/CIDRs to trust for X-Forwarded-For headers (leave blank to trust RFC1918 private subnets).
